\emph{Classes} column lists every lipid class in which the gene set was enriched;
a set appearing in one class is class-specific, one appearing in several is
generic. \emph{Genes} is the number of candidate genes carrying the term,
\emph{Background} the number of sorghum genes carrying it genome-wide, and
\emph{Intervals} the number of independent 250\,kb intervals those candidate genes
occupy. Fold enrichment is given as a range where a gene set was enriched in
several strata. $q_{\mathrm{LD}}$ is from the LD-aware permutation null; all rows
satisfy $q_{\mathrm{LD}}<0.05$. Interval count is reported but was not used to
select or rank terms.}\\
